title: Page2WebMCP
pitch: Turn any website into WebMCP layer in minutes. Works with OpenAPI specs as well.

 Inspiration 

 The adoption of WebMCP can be slow, since it requires website owners to develop and publish a new layer. I thought to myself - why can't this be automated? 

 What it does 

 Page2WebMCP is an AI agent that goes to a website, uses it like a real user (including authentication) and generates an embbedable javascript bundle with the WebMCP layer for your website. 

 How we built it 

 Codex + BrowserUse 

 Challenges we ran into 

 Website Ownership verification is sitll a cumbersome step, but it's necessary. 

 Accomplishments that we're proud of 

 The WebMCP layer gets automatically created from website url or OpenAPI spec or the Github repository. 

 What we learned 

 Developing a production-ready webmcp layer is difficult. 

 What's next for Page2WebMCP 

 We'll build a company around it
